## What is being discussed

The study evaluates temperature and dew-point biases in ERA5-Land data across built-up UK environments and considers how those biases propagate into urban climate applications.

## Why it may be relevant

It shows how infrastructure-level data limitations can affect downstream urban climate decisions.
